paul: Quick drop I sketched a lightweight "stabilization sprint" + "safety lattice" pattern to make long refactors less risky. link: https://redwood.internal/notes/stabilization-sprint :sparkles:
nina: sounds useful. what's the safety lattice?
paul: short: a set of independent guardrails teams must attach before a cut: interface fence, migration quota, canary recipe, compatibility harness, and a minimal fallback operator command. thinking these are checkbox gates in the RFC.
kevin: can you paste the minimal canary recipe and gating rules? makes it concrete for teams.
paul: pasted minimal canary recipe:
```
- ramp: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% over 72h
- metrics: error_rate, p99_latency, consumer_backcompat_fail, reconciliation_mismatch
- rollback triggers: error_rate > baseline + 0.25% OR p99 > baseline * 1.2 OR consumer_backcompat_fail > 0.05%
- safety hold: any critical tenant alert pauses ramp and requires two approvals
```
tori: add a staging soak: 24h of synthetic traffic parity before first percent. also require a nightly diff job for week 1 to highlight contract drift.
kevin: funding: propose two options: (A) stabilize credit pool (teams apply) or (B) fund 10% steady time + one 3-week stabilization sprint per quarter. I prefer hybrid: small steady + occasional focused window.
paul: hybrid aligns with other proposals. also proposing "voucher" model: platform issues 2-week vouchers to teams for adapter work; larger cross-team cuts get matched vouchers from product budget.
nina: operational ask: include a tiny manifest snippet for each fence with fields: owner, steward, runway_weeks, vouchers_used, compatibility_badge, rollback_thresholds. that'll show up in the Console.
kevin: compatibility harness: two parts: CI equivalence test (sampled inputs) and nightly production synthetic that replays 1k calls and diffs outputs. require green CI before each ramp.
tori: migration quotas: per-consumer quotas we track weekly. infra-bot can auto-alert owners when a consumer falls behind and generate a migration retro if >2 missed quotas.
paul: infra-bot: can we make a button in Console to issue a voucher and create the stub manifest?
infra-bot: feature-request logged: INT-4281. created runbook skeleton: #runbooks/stabilization-sprint/1987659999. created feature-flag `stabilization_safety_lattice_v1` (off by default).
kevin: tooling: we need a tiny `compat-verify` CLI teams can run locally to produce a compatibility badge file for PRs. I'll prototype next week.
nina: metrics to show impact: cross-service incidents/month, deploy-flake-rate, median time-to-merge adapter PRs, and consumer-backcompat-rate. propose a Dashboard tile with those four.
tori: pilot candidates: model-proxy (high value), session-orchestrator (high fanout), shared-kv-schema (blocking deploys). owners: serving, infra, data.
paul: i'll fold this into an RFC draft with checklist, voucher flow, manifest snippet, canary recipe, and proposed dashboard. aim: RFC by Wed, pilot kickoff in 3 weeks. :calendar:
kevin: +1. this feels actionable. :thumbsup:
nina: thanks all. tagging owners and will start tickets.
